result.question: Quais são os 10 municípios com maior taxa de mortalidade em internações obstétricas, entre aqueles com mais de 200 internações obstétricas e taxa acima da média nacional obstétrica?
result.gold_sql: WITH media_obs AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media_obstetrica FROM internacoes i WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_obstetrico, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_mort_obstetrica, ROUND(mo.taxa_media_obstetrica, 4) AS media_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_obs mo WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mo.taxa_media_obstetrica HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > mo.taxa_media_obstetrica ORDER BY taxa_mort_obstetrica DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH taxa_mortalidade AS ( SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 ), media_nacional AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_media FROM internacoes i WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 ) SELECT tm.municipio, tm.taxa_mortalidade FROM taxa_mortalidade tm, media_nacional mn WHERE tm.taxa_mortalidade > mn.taxa_media ORDER BY tm.taxa_mortalidade DESC LIMIT 10;
